# Sea Haven

> A personal-watercraft racing game that runs in the browser: ride a jet ski
> along generated northern shores through buoy gates and airborne rings, on
> water built from real wave physics — on phone and desktop, installable as a
> PWA, offline once loaded. No account, no download, free.

The game boots straight onto the water. Four craft ship — the skiff, the
marlin, the otter and the dart — and every level is generated from a seed by
a rules engine: a stretch of shore, the sea beside it, a course within a
hundred metres of the coast, ramps before every air gate, and the wind that
sets the sea. The waves are a Gerstner sum off a fetch-limited spectrum; the
hull floats by displacement, planes by Savitsky's lift and steers by its jet.

## Play

- [Play Sea Haven](https://game3.niclaslindstedt.se/): the game itself.
- [Privacy policy](https://game3.niclaslindstedt.se/privacy/): nothing leaves the device.
- [Support](https://game3.niclaslindstedt.se/support/): where progress lives, what to send with a bug.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/game3): engine, level
  generator, simulation harness, and the PWA shell. Noncommercial license.
